description: Language ingestion registry — the DATA source of truth for which languages Absorb can parse, the grammar each needs, and the extractor that implements it. NORTH_STAR rule #4: languages are data, not hardcoded core vocabulary. This file is the contract the drift gate enforces (scripts/check-language-registry.mjs): every registered adapter MUST appear here as implemented/native, and every implemented grammar MUST be an installed dep. The @language_adapter .holo trait is the native end-state where the extractor queries themselves become data (see research/2026-06-05_brittney-capability-gaps.md §C, sug_1780711395408_m35r).

statuses.implemented: Has a tree-sitter adapter class wired in adapters/index.ts; grammar is an installed dep.
statuses.native: Parsed via @holoscript/core (no tree-sitter); the HoloScript-native path.
statuses.declared: Present in the SupportedLanguage type but NO adapter exists yet — a build target. Adding one today still needs a core class; the @language_adapter trait removes that friction.
statuses.fallback: Plaintext path — BM25/embeddings over raw text, no structural extraction.
